name: Vantablack Workforce Immersion Group
description: A wholly owned Vantablack Media subsidiary contracted to produce mandatory orientation and compliance neural-feed content for corponation workforce integration programs, Vantablack Workforce Immersion Group supplies onboarding immersions to over forty licensed corponation clients across the GLMZ corridor. Their productions are technically classified as entertainment under Vantablack's licensing framework, allowing the studio to count mandatory corporate viewership hours toward quarterly engagement metrics. Critics within the industry note that VWIG content is indistinguishable in production quality from aspirational lifestyle programming, a design choice that is not accidental.
cultural_impact: VWIG's blurring of entertainment and mandatory compliance content accelerated widespread public distrust of corporate neural-feed programming and contributed to the growth of voluntary feed-refusal communities throughout the 2210s.
story_hooks: A newly hired Tier 2 worker begins experiencing intrusive behavioral compulsions after completing their VWIG onboarding immersion and starts quietly investigating whether the content was tampered with.
A whistleblower inside VWIG's content review division attempts to pass evidence of active conditioning sequences to an independent journalist before their contract is terminated.

A character is hired by a mid-tier corponation to produce a custom VWIG compliance immersion but is given a creative brief that crosses into territory they recognize as coercive psychological manipulation.
